offering_description.value: Cricut sells connected cutting machines, heat presses, tools and craft materials to home crafters and small businesses. It designs the equipment, outsources manufacturing and operates an app for creating projects and sending designs to its machines. Paid subscriptions unlock a library of designs and fonts and additional editing features.

primary_products.value: electronic craft cutting machines; heat presses; blades, mats and crafting tools; vinyl, iron-on transfers and other craft materials; digital designs and fonts

primary_services.value: craft design and machine-control software; subscription access to digital designs, fonts and premium editing features

customer_segment.value: B2C: Home crafters, hobbyists and people making personalized items; B2B: Small craft businesses and sellers of custom goods

end_markets.value: arts and crafts; personalized gifts and home décor; custom apparel; handmade goods

revenue_model.value: product sales: Cutting machines, heat presses, tools, consumable materials and individual digital designs; subscription: Recurring access to designs, fonts and premium editing features

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: Designs machines and supplies made by contract manufacturers and sells them to retailers, crafters and small businesses; software / platform: Combines digital content and design tools in an app that lets crafters create projects and control their machines

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe, Australia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Connected cutting machines, heat presses, craft tools and materials, design software and digital content

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: Craft supply chains, mass-market retailers and specialty retailers; online: Company web store, retail websites, online marketplaces and in-app purchases

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Consumer product safety and electrical equipment standards for machines, plus data privacy rules for connected software
